summary: Irretrievable marriage breakdown; four-month marital life; divorce granted with Rs.25 lacs alimony; Article 142 invoked despite opposition; maintenance dispute resolved; joint litigation history; no children; husband's public sector employment; wife's unemployment; settlement conditions enforced; compliance monitoring ordered.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; divorce granted subject to Rs.25 lacs alimony payment within six months; Rs.2 lacs deposit released; maintenance adjusted; proceedings closed on compliance.
